final: WITH acct_region AS (SELECT t.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS acct_avg FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(acct_avg) AS region_avg FROM acct_region GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS overall_avg FROM region_avg WHERE region_avg IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT r.region AS region, r.region_avg AS region_avg, r.region_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM region_avg r JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE r.region_avg > o.overall_avg), final_avg AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg) AS final_avg FROM kept WHERE region_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT k.region, k.region_avg, k.diff, k.region_avg / f.final_avg AS ratio FROM kept k JOIN final_avg f ON f.final_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY k.region
